blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) annotate and scale political text or constructs by generating text tokens. A new class of models, which TypeSafe markets as “System One” models, instead returns decisions and probability distributions across a user-supplied fixed answer set. A commercial model, JEV, is advertised as having a dramatic cost and speed advantage over traditional LLMs along with better calibrated decisions. As such, it might be useful for social scientists looking to quickly and cost-effectively annotate or scale large corpora of text and have a reliable indicator of a classifier’s uncertainty. Yet, the accuracy of these claims and the broader model accuracy in social science text-based tasks are not yet established. In this paper, we do just that and hope to establish the suitability of JEV for social science tasks. We compare JEV with LLMs and human coders from published research, and with a current mid-tier commercial LLM (GPT-6 Luna) and an open-weight alternative (Qwen3.8-27B). We find that JEV matches, or comes close to, the capabilities of both LLMs in a variety of tasks. However, we find no cost advantage over GPT-6 Luna at OpenAI’s batch prices. Further, we find that, when each question is asked once, JEV’s probabilities are better calibrated than GPT-6 Luna’s token probabilities, but not consistently better than Qwen3.8-27B’s. We conclude that unless researchers have a need for speed, JEV’s only obvious advantage is ease of parsing the underlying choice probabilities. Keywords: large language models, text as data, measurement,
annotation, scaling, pairwise comparison, Bradley-Terry
blocks.zh:
大语言模型(LLMs)通过生成文本符来注释并缩放政治文本或构造. 一种新的模型类别,即“安全系统1”作为“系统1”的模型进行市场销售,而是在用户提供的固定答案集中返回决定和概率分布。 一个商业模式JEV被公示为具有比传统有限责任公司更大的成本和速度优势,以及更好的校正决定。 因此,如果社会科学家能够快速和以成本效益高的方式对大块文字进行注释或规模化,并对分类者的不确定性有一个可靠的指标,则可能是有益的。 然而,这些说法的准确性和社会科学文本任务中更广泛的模型准确性尚未确定。 在本文中,我们这样做,并希望确定JEV是否适合社会科学任务。 我们比较JEV与已出版研究的LLMs和人文编码器,以及当前中层商业LLM(GPT-6 Luna)和开重替代品(Qune3.8-27B). 我们发现JEV在各种任务中匹配或接近两个LLM的能力. 与GPT-6 Luna相比, 此外,我们发现,当每个问题被问到一次时,JEV的概率比GPT-6 Luna的象征性概率更好校正,但并非始终好于Qune3.8-27B. 我们的结论是,除非研究者需要速度,否则JEV唯一的明显优势就是容易分析潜在的选择概率。 关键词:大语言模型,文本作为数据,测量,
注释、缩放、对比、布拉德利-特里

blocks.en: What JEV returns
blocks.zh: JEV 返回的内容

blocks.en: A JEV request contains a state and typed questions. The “state” is the text to be judged, while each question specifies what the model should decide and supplies the answer options against which it should evaluate that text ( TypeSafe, 2026 ) . Users can pick one of three output types: Choice, Score or Noul. “Choice” returns a named option and probabilities over user-supplied options. “Score” accepts two to ten worded levels and returns their probability-weighted mean, with the probability assigned to each level. “Noul” returns the probability of a positive answer to a binary question. Researchers therefore receive an answer distribution directly, without parsing a generated explanation or extracting a category from free text. Beyond these probabilities, a Choice answer also carries a “confidence” value. In our outputs it is almost exactly a rescaling of the probability of the chosen option (correlation 0.9997), so we treat it as adding nothing beyond the probabilities and do not analyse it separately.
blocks.zh: JEV请求包含状态和打出的问题. “状态”是有待判断的案文,而每个问题都具体说明该模式应决定什么,并提供它应据以评价该案文的答案选项(TypeSafe, 2026)。 用户可以选择三种输出类型之一:选择,分数或努尔. “选择”返回给定的选项和概率,而不是用户提供的选项。 “分数”接受2至10个有字级,并返回其概率加权平均值,并分配给每个等级的概率。 “ Noul” 返回对二进制问题作出肯定答案的概率。 因此,研究人员直接得到一个答案分布,而没有解析生成的解释或从免费文本中取出一个类别。 除了这些概率之外,选择的答案还具有“信心”价值。 在我们的产出中,它几乎完全是对所选择的选项的概率的调整(correction 0.9997),所以我们把它视为除了概率之外没有增加任何东西,并且不单独分析.

blocks.en: These probabilities resemble the token probabilities (log probabilities) that many LLM APIs report for their output. In this case, however, the probabilities are defined over the answer options rather than over possible tokens. A log probability describes the next token, so the researcher must map tokens to answer labels, discard mass on tokens that are not labels, and renormalise. Closed APIs also truncate what they report, or report no probabilities at all. For GPT-6 Luna, OpenAI returns at most the five most probable tokens at each position, so on a nine-point scale some levels receive no probability at all, and it returns none when the model reasons before answering. Anthropic does not report token probabilities at all. Even open-weight models accessed through an inference service will often limit the available probabilities. JEV returns a probability for every option the researcher supplies, rounded to two decimal places, regardless of the number of options.
blocks.zh: 这些概率类似于许多LLM API报告其输出的符号概率(log概率). 然而,在这种情况下,概率的定义是答案选项,而不是可能的符号。 日志概率描述下个符号,因此研究者必须绘制符号地图以回答标签,丢弃不是标签的符号上的质量,并重新正常化. 关闭的API也会截断其报告的内容,或者完全不报告概率. GPT-6 Luna, 打开 AI最多返回每个位置上最有可能的5个符号,因此在9分尺度上,一些级别完全得不到概率,当模型在回答之前的原因时,它不返回. Anthropic完全不报告象征性概率. 即使通过推论服务访问的开放式模型也往往会限制现有的概率. JEV返回研究者提供的每个选项的概率,四舍五入到小数点后两个位数,无论选项数多少.

blocks.en: TypeSafe calls its post-training method reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), which it says optimizes for “epistemically honest probabilities”, so that higher confidence means higher accuracy ( TypeSafe, 2026 ) . A calibrated model’s answers given probability 0.8 should be correct about 80% of the time across many answers. TypeSafe does not publish the training data, the reward or the architecture, so we cannot check the method directly. We can, however, check its implication against “gold standard” human benchmarks. Whatever calibration RLCD achieves, it achieves on TypeSafe’s training data. Calibration depends on the data as well as the model, so probabilities calibrated on one set of texts need not be calibrated on another. As such, it is no obvious that the RLCD would translate to honest calibration across all uses cases.
blocks.zh: TypeSafe称其用于校正决定(RLCD)的训练后强化方法学习,它称它优化了“持续诚实的概率”,因此,更高的信心意味着更高的精度(TypeSafe, 2026). 一个校准模型给出的概率为0.8的答案应该正确,在很多答案中大约80%的时间。 TypeSafe不发布训练数据,奖励或架构,因此不能直接检查方法. 然而,我们可以对照“黄金标准”的人类基准来检查其含义。 无论校准RLCD的成绩如何,它都能在TypeSafe的训练数据上实现. 校正取决于数据以及模型,所以对一组文本的校正概率不需要对另一组文本进行校正. 因此,并不明显的是,《生殖健康手册》将转化为对所有用途的诚实校正。

blocks.en: Still, the underlying choice probabilities produced by JEV are potentially its most important contribution. As we mentioned, LLM token probabilities are limited and not always available. Research suggests that the token probabilities of chat-tuned LLMs are often a poor guide to how often an answer is “right”. The largest pretrained models are reasonably well calibrated on multiple-choice questions whose options are shown to them ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ) . However, post-training (reinforcement learning) for chat undoes much of this, although a simple temperature adjustment largely restores it ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ) . On a subset of the MMLU benchmark, GPT-4’s expected calibration error on its answer probabilities rose from 0.007 before post-training to 0.074 after post-training ( OpenAI, 2023 ) . For GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4 and Claude 1 and 2, answer probabilities estimated from repeated samples are poorly calibrated, and the confidence a model states when asked is often better calibrated, in some cases halving the calibration error ( Tian et al., 2023 ) . One proposed contributor is that the reward models used in this training favor responses that state high confidence regardless of their quality ( Leng et al., 2025 ) . Reasoning models, whose token probabilities commercial APIs usually do not return, often state confidence above 85% even on answers they get wrong ( Mei et al., 2025 ) . Below, we compare JEV with GPT-6 Luna and Qwen3.8-27B to see whether its probabilities track correctness better than theirs do.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,JEV产生的潜在选择概率可能是其最重要的贡献. 正如我们提到的那样,LLM符号概率有限,并不总是可以得到。 研究表明,聊天调整的LLMs的象征性概率往往不足以说明答案常常是“正确”。 最大的预先训练过的模型在多种选择问题上得到相当好的校准,并向它们展示选择(Kadavath等人,2022年)。 然而,聊天的后培训(强制学习)消除了其中的很多,尽管简单的温度调整在很大程度上可以恢复(Kadavath等人,2022年). 关于MMLU基准的一个子集,GPT-4的答案概率的预期校正误差从训练后前的0.007升至训练后后的0.074(OpenAI, 2023). 对于GPT-3.5-turbo,GPT-4和Claude 1和2,从重复样本中估计的答案概率校正不准确,当被问及时一个模型的置信度常被更好的校正,在某些情况下将校正误差减半(Tian等,2023年). 提议的一个贡献者是,这次培训中使用的奖励模式有利于那些无论质量如何都具有高度信心的对策(Leng等人,2025年)。 理性模型,其象征概率商业API通常不会回落,往往甚至根据错误的答案(Mei等,2025年),表示超过85%的信心. 下面,我们比较JEV和GPT-6 Luna和Qune3.8-27B,看看其概率跟踪正确性是否比他们的好.

blocks.en: JEV’s exact architecture also remains unknown. TypeSafe states that JEV reads the state once and evaluates the questions in parallel, producing its outputs in one query, but provides no technical account from which we can verify how those evaluations are performed ( TypeSafe, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: JEV的确切建筑也依然未知. TypeSafe表示,JEV读取状态一次并同时评价问题,在一个查询中产生其产出,但没有提供任何技术账户,我们可以从中核实这些评价是如何进行的(TypeSafe, 2026).

blocks.en: How does JEV compare to LLMs and humans?
blocks.zh: JEV与LLMS和人类的对比如何?.

blocks.en: There have been a variety of papers published in political science and the social sciences more broadly to assess the ability of LLMs to complete tasks assigned to human coders and encoder-only models like BERT. Here we replicate several of these analyses, using the validation benchmarks of these existing studies, to see how JEV compares with these benchmarks, previous-generation LLMs, and the two contemporary models we mentioned above. Table 1 identifies the papers and tasks within those papers that we replicate here with JEV called via OpenRouter (for V-Dem, TypeSafe’s own endpoint), GPT-6 Luna called directly from OpenAI servers, and Qwen3.8-27B called via a third-party inference provider (Together.ai).
blocks.zh: 在政治学和社会科学中发表过各种论文,以更广泛地评估LLMS完成分配给BERT等人类编码器和编码器独家模型的任务的能力. 在这里,我们利用这些现有研究的验证基准,复制了其中的几项分析,以了解JEV如何与这些基准、上一代的LLMs以及我们上文提到的两个当代模型进行比较。 表1列出了我们通过OpenRouter(为V-Dem, TypeSafe本身的终点)、由OpenAI服务器直接呼叫的GPT-6 Luna(GPT-6 Luna)和通过第三方推论提供商(Together.

blocks.en: Our replications include five reading (scaling and annotation) applications and two tasks which rely on the models’ embedded knowledge to generate new data. Regarding the latter, the first attempts to create an ideological scaling of European political parties ( Di Leo et al., 2025 ) and the second reproduces V-Dem’s expert codes for 53 indicators in 2023 ( Weidmann et al., 2026 ) . We retain each published task and prompt wording where the interface permits, removing reply-format instructions that JEV cannot follow. Appendix A records the prompts, and Appendices C, F and G document changes to answer options and rating scales.
blocks.zh: 我们的复制包括五个读取(缩放和注释)应用程序和两个依赖于模型嵌入的知识生成新数据的任务. 关于后者,第一次试图建立欧洲政党意识形态规模(Di Leo等,2025年),第二次尝试转载了V-Dem在2023年53项指标的专家代码(Weidmann等,2026年)。 我们保留了每一个已公布的任务,并在界面允许的情况下迅速措辞,删除JEV无法遵循的回复格式指令. 附 录 A记录了提示,并附加了C,F和G文档的更改以回答选项和评分表.

blocks.en: We first assess the speed and cost of JEV given that these are the advantages highlighted in its marketing. Table 2 compares cost and speed on the primary task of each application. JEV is not cheaper than GPT-6 Luna at OpenAI’s Batch prices. Luna costs less on six of the seven tasks and about the same (3% more) on the seventh. Against Luna’s Standard prices, which apply when answers are needed at once rather than within a day, JEV is cheaper on six of the seven tasks. We ran inference on Qwen through an external provider’s API (OpenRouter, served by a single host, Parasail, at 8-bit precision). 2 2 2 Batch processing was not available for this model. In this case, Qwen was more expensive than both GPT-6 Luna and JEV, at 2.35 to 5.41 times JEV’s cost per decision. However, given the model’s small size, many scholars can run it on a local commercial machine or better yet on university supercomputer infrastructure at no cost to the researcher.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评估JEV的速度和成本,因为这些是其营销中突出的优势. 表2比较了每个应用程序主要任务的成本和速度。 JEV并不比OpenAI批量价格的GPT-6 Luna便宜. 露娜在7个任务中的6个任务上花费较少,在7个任务上花费大约相同(多出3%). JEV在7项任务中, 我们通过外部供应商的API(OpenRouter, 由单一主机Parasail以8位精度提供服务)对Quen进行推断。 2 2 批件处理不可用。 在这种情况下,Quen比GPT-6 Luna和JEV都要贵,每个决定的JEV成本为2.35至5.41倍. 然而,鉴于模型规模很小,许多学者可以在当地商业机器上运行,或者在大学的超级计算机基础设施上运行,而研究人员无需付出任何费用。

blocks.en: JEV is faster than the two alternatives. Sending one request at a time, it returned each decision in 0.09 to 0.27 seconds, against 0.75 to 1.04 seconds for Luna and 0.39 to 0.87 for Qwen. 3 3 3 These timings come from one location on two consecutive days, and throughput with many requests at once depends on the route and rate limits in force, so the table shows the size of the speed difference in our runs rather than a fixed property of any of the models. We now proceed to examine the accuracy of JEV in each of the annotation and scaling tasks.
blocks.zh: JEV比两种替代品更快. 它一次发出一个请求,在0.09至0.27秒内将每个决定退回,而月球0.75至1.04秒,Quen0.39至0.87秒。 这些时间来自连续两天的一个地点,吞吐量同时有许多请求,这取决于生效的路线和速率限制,因此表格显示了我们运行速度差异的大小,而不是任何一个模型的固定属性. 我们现在着手审查JEV在每个注释和缩放任务的准确性。

blocks.en: Tweet relevance
blocks.zh: 图文相关性

blocks.en: Gilardi et al. (2023) were among the first to show that LLMs could provide high-quality annotations of a common task: annotating tweets. They use tweets from Alizadeh et al. (2022) , who collected English-language tweets about content moderation through Twitter’s academic API from January 2020 to April 2021, about 2.6 million tweets after filtering. Gilardi et al. (2023) drew a random sample from this corpus and added a new sample of tweets from January 2023, collected the same way. 4 4 4 Two trained research assistants coded each tweet for relevance and for whether it presents content moderation as a problem or a solution. In their replication archive, both agreed on 2,403 of the 2,559 double-coded tweets in the 2021 sample (93.9% agreement) and on 411 of 480 in the 2023 sample (85.6%); we score only these. For the frames, the agreed sets for the two frame questions hold 2,361 and 2,398 tweets in 2021 and 166 and 170 in 2023. The tasks we replicate are whether a tweet is relevant to content moderation and, separately, whether it frames content moderation as a problem or as a solution.
blocks.zh: Gilardi等人(2023年)是最早显示LLMS可以提供高质量说明共同任务的人物之一:注解推特. 他们使用Alizadeh等人(2022年)的推文,他们通过Twitter的学术API收集了有关内容节制的英语推文,从2020年1月至2021年4月,过滤后约有260万个推文. Gilardi等(2023年)从这个活体中抽取了随机样本,并添加了从2023年1月起的推特新样本,收集方式相同. 页:1 4 两名训练有素的研究助理对每个推特进行编码,以了解其相关性,以及它是否将内容节制作为一个问题或解决办法。 在复制档案中,双方同意了2021年样本2,559个双码微博中的2,403个(93.9%的协议),以及2023年样本480个(85.6%)中的411个;我们只得这些. 对于框架,两个框架问题的商定套件在2021年和166年以及2023年分别持有2,361和2,398个推特. 我们重复的任务是,一个推特是否与内容节制相关,另外,它是否将内容节制设定为问题或解决方案。

blocks.en:
JEV beats the GPT-3.5 model used in the original study if we treat the trained annotators as the proper baseline. However, JEV is below GPT-6 Luna in both samples, and level with or below Qwen3.8-27B. GPT-6 Luna reaches 91.1% accuracy against JEV’s 89.0% on the 2021 tweets and 84.2% against 76.2% on the 2023 tweets, with both paired intervals excluding zero. Qwen3.8-27B (Table 10 ) is level with JEV on the 2021 tweets (accuracy 88.2%, a difference of − 0.8 -0.8 points [ − 2.1 -2.1 , 0.4]), but above JEV on the 2023 tweets (accuracy 79.6%, a difference of + 3.4 +3.4 [0.2, 6.8]), although this lead depends on the bootstrap seed. Qwen is below GPT-6 Luna on both tweet samples. On the two frame questions, for which we rebuilt the instructions, Qwen is above JEV on the problem frame for the 2023 tweets ( + 7.8 +7.8 points [1.2, 14.5]), but below JEV on the solution frame for the 2021 tweets ( − 3.4 -3.4 [ − 4.4 -4.4 , − 2.3 -2.3 ]). Qwen is level with JEV in the other two cells (Appendix C).
The criterion is the label agreed by two trained research assistants. Table 4 and Appendix C retain the historical comparison with crowd workers and ChatGPT, along with JEV’s repeated-run results.
blocks.zh:
JEV优于原始研究中使用的GPT-3.5模型,如果我们把训练有素的注释者作为适当的基线. 然而,JEV在两个样本中都低于GPT-6 Luna,与Qune3.8-27B或低于Qune3. GPT-6 Luna在2021年的微博上与JEV的89.0%的比分达到91.1%的准确度,在2023年的微博上与76.2%的比分达到84.2%,两者的对接间隔均排除了零. Qwen3.8-27B(表10)在2021发微博上与JEV为平分(准确度为88.2%,相差为-0.8-0.8分[-2.1-2.1分,0.4分]),但在2023发微博上则高于JEV(准确度为79.6%,相差为+3.4+3.4 [0.2, 6.8分]),不过这一领先取决于靴子种子. Quen在GPT-6 Luna的微博标本之下。 关于我们重建指示的两个框架问题,Quen在2023年微博的问题框架(+ 7.8+7.8分 [1.2, 14.5])上高于JEV,但在2021年微博的解决方案框架(−3.4-3.4 [− 4.4-4.4,− 2.3-2.3])下低于JEV. Quen在另外两个单元格(Appendix C)中与JEV为等分.
标准是两名训练有素的研究助理同意的标签. 表4和附录 C保留了与人群工人和ChatGPT的历史对比,以及JEV反复运行的结果.

blocks.en: Tweet sentiment
blocks.zh: Tweet 情绪

blocks.en: Ornstein et al. (2025) classify the sentiment in 945 tweets about two Supreme Court decisions and correlate a continuous score with the mean of three expert judgments. 5 5 5 The tweets are the authors’ own collection: posts referring to the US Supreme Court within 24 hours of two decisions, Masterpiece Cakeshop v. Colorado Civil Rights Commission in 2018 (423 tweets) and Trump v. Mazars and Trump v. Vance , released on the same day in 2020 (522 tweets). The three expert coders labelled each tweet independently as positive, negative or neutral (Fleiss’ κ = 0.72 \kappa=0.72 ) and recoded disagreements in a second round. The benchmark is their mean on a seven-point scale from − 1 -1 to + 1 +1 . We compare models on the 907 tweets for which every measure is available. With their six few-shot examples and positive-minus-negative scoring (Table 5 ), JEV reaches 0.740, above the Twitter-sentiment RoBERTa model (0.659) and below GPT-4 (0.789) in correlation with the experts’ mean sentiment score. However, both contemporary models agree more closely with the experts than JEV does. GPT-6 Luna, given the same examples and scored by the GPT-4 rule, reaches 0.816, exceeding JEV by 0.076 [0.039, 0.112]. Using the examples and scoring the output the same way, Qwen3.8-27B reaches 0.841 [0.811, 0.868], higher than JEV by 0.102 [0.071, 0.131] and level with GPT-6 Luna ( + 0.025 +0.025 [ − 0.001 -0.001 , 0.052]). Without the examples Qwen3.8-27B answered in full sentences to almost all tweets (941 of 945), so we have no comparable score for the zero-shot prompt.
blocks.zh: Ornstein等人(2025年)在945个推特上对两项最高法院裁决的情绪进行了分类,并将连续得分与三项专家判决的平均值联系起来。 5,5 这些推特是作者自己的收藏:在2018年Masterpaper Cakeshop诉科罗拉多民权委员会案(423个推特)和特朗普诉马扎斯和特朗普诉万斯案(522个推特)两项裁决的24小时内, 三位专家将每个推文分别标为正,负或中(Fleiss's $ = 0.72\kappa= 0.72),并在第二轮中重新编码分歧. 基准是它们从− 1 - 1 到+ 1 + 1 的七分尺度的平均值. 我们比较了907个微博上的模型, JEV以6个数镜头和正负评分(表5)达到0.740分,高于Twitter-sentiment RoBERTa模式(0.659分),低于GPT-4(0.789分),与专家的平均情绪得分相关。 然而,这两个当代模式与专家的一致程度都高于JEV。 GPT-6 Luna给出了同样的例子并被GPT-4规则打出分数,达到0.816分,超过JEV0.076 [0.039,0.112]. 以同样的方式使用示例并给输出打分,Qune3.8-27B达到0.841 [0.811,0.868],比JEV高0.102 [0.071,0.131],与GPT-6 Luna(+0.025 + 0.025 [−0.001-0.001,0.052])相接. 没有这些例子,Qwen3.8-27B对几乎所有的微博(945分中的941分)都以满句回答,所以我们没有对应的分数来表示"零发快".

blocks.en: Terrorist attack type
blocks.zh: 恐怖袭击类型

blocks.en: Brandt et al. (2026) test two classification tasks that are meant to demonstrate test the utility of LLMs for building event datasets. First they classify the attack type of 37,709 Global Terrorism Database ( LaFree and Dugan, 2007 ; National Consortium for the Study of Terrorism and Responses to Terrorism (START), 2022 ) incidents into nine categories using each incident’s summary and motive. Next, they use 322 BBC news articles from 2004–05 ( Greene and Cunningham, 2006 ) and label them as conflict-related or not. 6 6 6 START researchers code each incident from media reports, screened by automated filters, following the GTD codebook. Each incident has a short narrative summary of who did what, when, where and how, an optional free-text motive, and up to three attack types. Brandt et al. (2026) train on incidents up to 2016 and test on 37,709 incidents from 2017 to 2020 (11,220, 9,722, 8,457 and 8,310 a year). The model reads the summary with the motive appended and is scored against the first attack type. In the BBC task 53 items are about conflict. In their study, they compare fine-tuned models (ConfliBERT and ConflLlama) with prompted LLMs (Gemma 2, Llama 3.1 and Qwen 2.5) that receive no codebook, only the category names. We test their original prompting strategy and also test whether providing a codebook, for context, leads to better outcomes. With category names alone (Table 11 ), JEV reaches accuracy 0.715 and macro F1 0.555 (the unweighted mean of the nine categories’ F1 scores; Sokolova and Lapalme 2009 ), while GPT-6 Luna reaches 0.709 and 0.544, placing Luna level with JEV on macro F1 and behind on accuracy. Qwen3.8-27B’s accuracy (0.680) and macro F1 (0.518) are both lower than JEV’s ( − 0.034 -0.034 [ − 0.037 -0.037 , − 0.032 -0.032 ] and − 0.038 -0.038 [ − 0.049 -0.049 , − 0.026 -0.026 ], respectively) and lower than GPT-6 Luna’s. Qwen marks 15 BBC articles as conflict and finds 6 of the 53 conflict articles, for a conflict F1 of 0.18, compared with 0.32 for JEV and 0.14 for Luna. ConfliBERT remains the stronger classifier, but it was fine-tuned on the labelled GTD incidents up to 2016, a training set that researchers starting a new task will rarely have.
blocks.zh: Brandt等 (2026)测试了两个分类任务,这些任务旨在测试LLMS用于构建事件数据集的实用性. 首先,他们利用每起事件的摘要和动机,将37 709起袭击类型全球恐怖主义数据库(LaFree and Dugan, 2007;国家恐怖主义研究和应对恐怖主义联合会,2022年)事件分为9个类别。 接下来,他们使用2004–05年的322 BBC新闻文章(Greene and Cunningham, 2006),并将其标注为与冲突有关与否. 6个6个START研究人员按照GTD代码表通过自动过滤器筛选的媒体报道对每起事件进行编码. 每起事件都有一个简短的叙述性总结,说明谁做了什么,何时,何地和如何做了一个可选的自由文字动机,最多有三种攻击类型. Brandt等 (2026) 至2016年的事故列车,2017至2020年的37,709起事故试验(每年11,220起,9,722起,8,457起和8,310起). 该型号阅读了附有动机的摘要并被打入了第一种攻击类型的分数. 在英国广播公司的任务中,53个项目是关于冲突的。 在他们的研究中,他们将微调模型(ConfliBERT和ConflLlama)与没有获得代码本的被激励LLMS(Gemma 2,Llama 3.1和Quen 2.5)进行比较,只有类名. 我们检验他们最初的促动策略,也检验提供代码本是否会导致更好的结果。 单是类别名称(表11),JEV就达到了精确度0.715和宏F1 0.555(9个类别F1分数的未加权平均值;Sokolova和Lapalme 2009),而GPT-6 Luna则达到了0.709和0.544,将与JEV的Luna平分放在宏F1上,而准确度则落后. Qune3.8-27B的精度(0.680)和宏F1(0.518)均低于JEV(−0.034-0.034 [−0.037-0.037],−0.032-0.032])和0.038 [−0.049-0.049,−0.026-0.026])并低于GPT-6 Luna. Quen将15篇BBC文章标为冲突,在53篇冲突文章中发现6篇,冲突F1为0.18,而JEV为0.32,而Luna为0.14. ConfliBERT仍然是更强的分类器,但是在标注为"到2016年的GTD"事件上进行了微调,这是研究人员开始新任务时很少有的一套培训.

blocks.en: Open-ended survey responses
blocks.zh: 不限成员名额的调查答复

blocks.en: DiGiuseppe and Flynn (2026) show that scales built from LLM pairwise comparisons agree more closely across models than naive (0--10) point-wise ratings do. Their first study scales 1,402 explanations of how interest rates are determined as a proxy for economic knowledge. Their second study scales uncertainty in respondent-supplied likely consequences of a potential breach of the US debt ceiling in 2023. 7 7 7 Both studies use nonprobability samples of US adults recruited on Prolific, with quotas on age, gender and partisanship in Study 1 and on age, sex and race or ethnicity in Study 2. Study 1 reuses the open-ended answers collected by DiGiuseppe et al. (2025) in the first wave of their survey, fielded on 6 August 2024, keeping the 1,402 respondents who said they had not looked up either answer, and compares them in 28,040 published pairs, twenty per respondent. Study 2 is a survey experiment fielded on 16 May 2023 that randomly assigned respondents to a control, a certain or an uncertain arm before asking what would happen if the debt ceiling were not raised (1,514 answers in the archived files, 502, 505 and 507 by arm; the published articles report 1,486) ( DiGiuseppe and Shea, 2025 ) . The human benchmark comes from respondents whose answers had been rated most knowledgeable and who were recontacted to compare pairs of answers. The archived files hold 460 judgments of 243 distinct pairs by 23 raters, each judging 20 pairs drawn from a pool of 300; the article reports 15 raters after screening and 300 rated pairs. Both fit a Bayesian Bradley-Terry model ( Bradley and Terry, 1952 ) to recover the scale from twenty comparisons per answer. We compare JEV with GPT-4o, the frontier model at the time of their study, and with the two contemporary models.
blocks.zh: DiGiuseppe和Flynn(2026年)显示,通过LLM对等比较构建的尺度在模型之间比天真(0-10分)的分分级更接近一致. 它们的第一个研究规模为1,402,解释利率如何作为经济知识的取而代之。 他们的第二次研究估计了2023年美国债务上限可能遭到违反的、答卷人提供的可能后果的不确定性。 7 7 两项研究都采用了在Prolific上招募的美国成年人的不概率样本,在研究1中规定了年龄、性别和党派配额,在研究2中规定了年龄、性别和种族或族裔配额。 第1研究重新利用了由DiGiuseppe等人(2025年)在他们于2024年8月6日进行的第一波调查中收集的开放式答案,保留了1,402个答复者称他们没有查阅任何答复,并以28,040个已公布的对数进行对比,每个答复者20个. 研究2是2023年5月16日进行的一项调查实验,随机将受访者分配到一个控制,某个特定或不确定的臂上,然后询问如果不提高债务上限会发生什么(存档档案中有1,514个答案,502,505和507个臂;已发表文章报告1,486 (DiGuseppe and Shea, 2025.). 人类基准来自答复者,他们的回答被评为最有知识,被重新整理以比较对答。 存档文件有460项判决,其中243对是23个评分,每个评分从300人中抽取20对;文章报告在筛选后有15个评分,有300对评分。 两者都符合贝叶斯人布拉德利-特瑞模型(Bradley和Terry,1952年),从每个回答的20个比较中恢复了比分. 我们比较JEV与GPT-4o,即研究时的前沿模型,以及两个当代模型.

blocks.en: Each study compares several language models, of varying sizes, on three tasks. The models judge the answers in pairs (there are 28,040 pairs in Study 1 and 30,280 in Study 2, with each answer paired with twenty others selected at random), rate each answer on a scale of 0 to 10 and, in Study 1 only, judge the pairs that the experts also judged. For each of these tasks we use the same pairs of answers and the same wording as the original, except that for JEV we leave out the lines about how the reply should be formatted. JEV judges each pair in both orders, with the published order as the primary specification. GPT-6 Luna and Qwen judge pairs only in the published order, except for the pairs judged by the experts, which they judge in both orders. For the ratings, we ask JEV to give each answer a Score on a ten-level scale and rescale these to the range of the original ratings. We also add two blocks of requests that are not in the original. The first has every pair among a random selection of 80 answers per study, in order to test transitivity. In the second we repeat requests, in order to test reliability.
blocks.zh: 每项研究都比较了三种不同规模的语言模型。 模型以对数(研究1中有28,040对,研究2中有30,280对)来判断答案,每个答案与另外20个随机选择的对数,以0到10的比例来判断每个答案,在研究1中,只判断专家也判断的对数. 对于其中的每一项任务,我们使用与原作相同的一对答案和相同的措辞,但对于JEV,我们只留下关于应如何格式化的行. JEV在两种订单中各评出一对,所公布的顺序为主要规格. GPT-6 Luna和Quen法官只在已公布的顺序中进行配对,但专家判断的配对除外,他们在两个顺序中都进行了判断. 对于收视率,我们要求JEV给每个回答一个十级分数,然后将这些分数调整到原收视率范围. 我们还增加了两个没有在原文中的请求。 第一种在随机选择每次研究80个答案中每对都有,以测试过渡性. 第二,我们重复请求,以测试可靠性。

blocks.en: The two contemporary models come as close to GPT-4o’s scale as JEV does. In Study 1, the scales they produce correlate with the GPT-4o scale at 0.935 for GPT-6 Luna and 0.942 for Qwen3.8-27B. JEV’s corresponding correlation is level with both (JEV minus Luna 0.002 [ − 0.004 -0.004 , 0.008] and JEV minus Qwen − 0.004 -0.004 [ − 0.009 -0.009 , 0.000]). Agreement among models can also reflect shared errors, so we turn to human judges. On the 243 expert-judged pairs (Table 8 ), GPT-4o reaches F1 = 0.828 and JEV 0.814 [0.764, 0.852]. The paired gap (GPT-4o minus JEV) of 0.014 [ − 0.014 -0.014 , 0.043] includes zero. GPT-6 Luna has an F1 of 0.817 [0.772, 0.856] and Qwen3.8-27B 0.782 [0.721, 0.831]. Both are level with JEV. In Study 2, compared with the certain arm, respondents in the uncertain arm score 0.256 [0.130, 0.383] standard deviations higher on JEV’s scale and 0.296 [0.166, 0.425] on GPT-4o’s. The contemporary models agree with this result, giving 0.239 [0.109, 0.361] on the GPT-6 Luna scale and 0.239 [0.110, 0.362] on the Qwen3.8-27B scale.
blocks.zh: 这两个当代模型和JEV一样接近于GPT-4o的尺度. 在研究1中,它们产生的天平与GPT-4o天平有关,GPT-6 Luna为0.935;Qune3.8-27B为0.942。 JEV 的相应关联性是水平(JEV 减去 0.002 [− 0.004-0.004, 0.008 ) 和 JEV 减去 Quen − 0.004-0.004 [− 0.009-0.009, 0.000] 。 模型之间的一致也可以反映共同的错误,因此我们转向人类法官。 在243对专家判断的对上(表8),GPT-4o达到F1=0.828,JEV为0.814 [0.764,0.852]. 0.014 [−0.014-0.014,0.043]的对接相差(GPT-4o-减JEV)包括0. GPT-6 Luna的F1有0.817 [0.772,0.856]和Qune3.8-27B 0.782 [0.721,0.831]. 两者都与JEV同为一等. 在"研究2"中,与某些手臂相比,不确定手臂的受访者得分为0.256分[0.130分,0.383分]标准差在JEV的比分上更高,而GPT-4o的比分为0.296分[0.166分,0.425分]. 当代的模型都同意这一结果,给出了0.239 [0.109,0.361] 在GPT-6 Luna比例尺上,给出了0.239 [0.110,0.362] 在Qune3.8-27B比例尺上.

blocks.en: Manifestos and speeches
blocks.zh: 宣言和演讲

blocks.en: Le Mens and Gallego (2025) use LLMs to position political texts on policy and ideological dimensions. They prompt an LLM to score each tweet or sentence on a specified scale, allowing an “NA” response when the text lacks relevant political content. For longer documents, they average the numeric sentence scores to estimate the document’s position. We repeat this with JEV, GPT-6 Luna and Qwen3.8-27B for 18,263 sentences from 18 British party manifestos on economic and social dimensions, and 429 sentences from 36 European Parliament speeches on coal subsidies. The benchmarks are document-level judgments. The manifesto targets are expert coding and the speech targets are crowd coding from Benoit et al. (2016) .
blocks.zh: Le Mens和Gallego(2025年)利用LLMs将政治文本置于政策和意识形态层面。 它们促使一个LLM按规定的规模对每个推文或句子进行分数,允许在文本缺乏相关政治内容时做出"NA"回应. 对于较长的文档,它们平均数字句子得分来估计文档的位置. 我们用JEV、GPT-6 Luna和Qune3.8-27B来重复18 263个关于经济和社会方面的英国政党宣言的判决,以及36个欧洲议会关于煤炭补贴的演讲中的429个判决。 基准是文件一级的判断。 宣言的目标为专家编码,而言论目标为来自Benoit等的人群编码(2016年)。

blocks.en: Both corpora are taken from Benoit et al. (2016) . The manifesto corpus contains the manifestos of the Conservatives, Labour and the Liberal Democrats at the six general elections from 1987 to 2010, 18,263 sentences in total. Each sentence was coded by four to six political scientists (faculty members and doctoral students), which gives about seven ratings per sentence once both coding orders are counted. The benchmark is the scaled expert position of each manifesto, as calculated by Benoit et al. (2016) . The speech corpus contains the 36 contributions to the European Parliament’s debate of 23 November 2010 on state aid to close uncompetitive coal mines, 429 sentences in their original languages. Crowd workers coded these in six language versions, and the benchmark is the average of the six crowd scores.
blocks.zh: 两只蝎子都取自Benoit等人(2016年). 《宣言》载有保守党、劳工党和自由民主党在1987年至2010年六次大选中发表的宣言,共18 263个判决。 每句由4至6名政治科学家(院士和博士生)编码,一旦计算出两个编码命令,每句就给出了大约7分的评分. 根据Benoit等人(2016年)的计算,基准是每项宣言的专家地位。 2010年11月23日欧洲议会关于国家援助关闭无竞争力煤矿的辩论, 人群工人用6个语言版本编码这些,基准是6个人群分数的平均值.

blocks.en: Le Mens and Gallego (2025) report four applications. These are tweets from members of the 118th US Congress, the positions of the senators of the 117th Congress based on their tweets, the British manifestos and the coal debate. We replicate the last two, using the same specifications as their main results. The manifestos are used without a description of the dimension, and the speeches in their original languages with a description. For JEV, instead of the 0–100 scale we use nine worded Score levels, and instead of the instruction to reply NA we add a separate yes/no question asking whether the sentence is relevant. We fixed the primary inclusion threshold at 0.5 before the run. For GPT-6 Luna and Qwen we use the published prompts, including the scale and the NA option.
blocks.zh: Le Mens和Gallego(2025年)报告了四个应用. 这些是来自美国第118届国会议员的推特,117届国会参议员根据他们的推特,英国宣言和煤炭辩论的立场. 我们复制了最后两个,使用与其主要结果相同的规格。 宣言的用法没有说明维度,发言的原文也有说明. 对JEV来说,我们不用0-100的分数表,而是使用9个有字分的分数等级,而不用回答NA的指示,我们只增加一个单独的是/否问题,询问该句是否相关. 我们把初入限定在跑前0.5 对于GPT-6 Luna和Quen,我们使用已公布的提示,包括比例表和NA选项.

blocks.en: JEV’s expected scores, averaged over included sentences, correlate 0.97 with the economic benchmark and 0.92 with the social benchmark, within the published models’ range but below the published GPT-4o results of 0.98 and 0.94, respectively. The speeches are harder. JEV reaches 0.81 on the 35 speeches with at least one sentence it judges relevant, below GPT-4o’s 0.93 (Table 14 ). GPT-6 Luna is above JEV on all three benchmarks (correlations of 0.977, 0.952 and 0.947), while Qwen3.8-27B is level with JEV on all three (0.974, 0.940 and 0.905, judged level by a paired bootstrap over documents).
blocks.zh: JEV的预期分数,平均高于包含的句子,在公布的模型范围内将0.97分与经济基准挂钩,将0.92分与社会基准挂钩,但分别低于公布的0.98分和0.94分的GPT-4o分数。 发言更难。 JEV在35个演讲中达到0.81分,它认为至少一个句子是相关的,低于GPT-4o的0.93分(表14). GPT-6 Luna在所有三个基准上都高于JEV(关系为0.977,0.952和0.947),而Quen3.8-27B则与JEV在所有三个基准上处于平分水平(0.974,0.940和0.905,由一对双靴子在文件上判断).

blocks.en: Party positions from party names
blocks.zh: 来自政党名称的政党立场

blocks.en: Di Leo et al. (2025) test whether an LLM can place European parties on a left–right scale from its own embedded knowledge. This allows for scaling of parties that have no common sources of votes or corpora. In the application, the model sees only two party names and must decide which is more right-wing. A Bradley-Terry model turns these pairwise answers into a scale, which is compared with Chapel Hill expert placements ( Jolly et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 迪·利奥等. (2025)测试LLM是否能够从自己的嵌入知识中将欧洲政党置于左-右比例. 这样就可以扩大没有共同的选票来源或公司来源的政党。 在申请中,模型只看到两个党名,必须决定哪个党更右翼. A Bradley-Terry模型将这些对偶的答案转换成比例尺,与Chapel Hill专家的安置(Jolly等,2022年)作比较.

blocks.en: The party names and benchmarks are from three sources. These are the Manifesto Project dataset ( Lehmann et al., 2024 ) , the Chapel Hill Expert Survey ( Jolly et al., 2022 ) , extended back to 1984 with the Ray–Marks–Steenbergen file ( Ray, 1999 ; Steenbergen and Marks, 2007 ) , whose left–right values come from earlier expert surveys for 1984 and 1996 and are interpolated for 1988 and 1992, and voters’ placements of parties in the harmonised True European Voter surveys ( Schmitt, 2021 ) . Placements from the Comparative Study of Electoral Systems ( The Comparative Study of Electoral Systems, 2024 ) provide an alternative benchmark. We have one sample per European Parliament election between 1979 and 2019. Each sample includes the European parties that ran in a national election in the four years before that European Parliament election. The samples contain from 112 to 362 parties from 18 to 39 countries. Each party is compared with every other party in its sample, which gives 347,801 dyads in total. From 1984 on there are such placements for between 74 and 239 parties a year (those used for 1989 are mostly interpolations), and for 1979 there are none.
blocks.zh: 政党名称和基准来自三个方面。 这些是《宣言》项目数据集(Lehmann等,2024年),礼拜山专家调查(Jolly等,2022年),与Ray-Marks-Steenbergen档案(Ray,1999年;Steenbergen和Marks,2007年)一起延伸至1984年,其左偏右值取自1984年和1996年较早的专家调查,并被插入1988年和1992年,选民在协调的"真欧选民调查"(Schmitt,2021年)中的政党位置. 《选举制度比较研究》(2024年《选举制度比较研究》)中的职位安排提供了另一种基准。 在1979年至2019年间,我们每个欧洲议会选举有一个样本. 每个样本包括欧洲政党,这些政党在欧洲议会选举之前的四年里参加了全国选举。 这些样本包含来自18至39个国家的112至362个缔约方。 每一方都与样本中的任何其他方相提并论,共计347,801克。 从1984年起,每年有74至239个政党被安置(1989年使用的政党大多是插图),1979年没有。

blocks.en: The task covers the whole of the main analysis in the original, which concerns the left–right dimension only, with every dyad in every year. Di Leo et al. (2025) take the most common answer of seven runs. We use only one run. For JEV we remove the closing instruction to reply with exactly “Party 1” or “Party 2”, but we keep the original order of presentation. We do not repeat the robustness analyses in their supplementary material, such as pooled years, few-shot prompts or other framings.
blocks.zh: 这项任务涵盖了原作中的全部主要分析,只涉及左-右层面,每年的每个 dyad 。 Di Leo等 (2025) 以7跑最为常见的回答. 我们只用一次 对JEV来说,我们删除了最后指示,即用“第1个缔约方”或“第2个缔约方”来答复,但我们保持原来的表述顺序。 我们不重复在其补充材料中的强性分析,例如集合年份、几发提示或其他框架。

blocks.en: Across the 8 election years, JEV’s scale correlates on average (Table 13 ) 0.877 with the experts, above the 0.772 of the GPT-3.5 model in the original study, although their supplement reports that GPT-4o and Llama-3.1 70B did better than GPT-3.5. GPT-6 Luna averages 0.844, and its difference from JEV is indistinguishable from zero in all 8 years. Qwen3.8-27B averages 0.755 and is below JEV in all eight years, with differences of between 0.09 and 0.15.
blocks.zh: 在8个选举年中,JEV的比额平均与专家相关(表13)为0.877,高于最初研究中GPT-3.5模型的0.772,尽管他们的补充报告GPT-4o和Llama-3.1 70B的比GPT-3.5好. GPT-6 Luna平均0.844分,它与JEV的区别在所有8年中都与0分不开. Qwen3.8-27B平均为0.755,并在所有8年中都低于JEV,相差0.09至0.15.

blocks.en: Democracy indicators from country names
blocks.zh: 国名中的民主指标

blocks.en: Weidmann et al. (2026) ask whether LLMs can reproduce V-Dem expert codes. The model receives a country’s name, the year and a V-Dem question with its answer scale, and returns a code. We repeat this for 53 indicators in 171 countries in 2023. JEV’s codes correlate 0.68 with V-Dem’s on average (Table 12 ), above GPT-4o (0.63) and Llama-3.1 70B (0.50), recomputed from the original study’s published codes (the article reports 0.64 for GPT-4o), and above GPT-6 Luna (0.63) and Qwen3.8-27B (0.59). All models do worse on the codes that changed from the previous year.
blocks.zh: Weidmann等人(2026年)询问LLMS是否能够复制V-Dem专家代码. 该模型收到一个国名,年份和V-Dem问题,并带有答案尺度,并返回代码. 我们在2023年171个国家的53个指标中重复了这一点。 JEV的代码平均与V-Dem的代码(表12)相接0.68,高于GPT-4o(0.63)和Llama-3.1 70B(0.50),与原研究公布的代码(GPT-4o的文章报告为0.64)相接;高于GPT-6 Luna(0.63)和Qune3.8-27B(0.59)。 所有模型都比前一年的代码更糟糕。

blocks.en: We use version 14 of V-Dem ( Coppedge et al., 2024c ; Coppedge et al., 2024a ) , coded for 2023, as the benchmark. The 53 indicators are the ordinal, expert-coded indicators that Weidmann et al. (2026) selected from the components of V-Dem’s five high-level democracy indices; indicators coded only in election years are not among them. Each code is based on the ratings of several country experts (a median of six per code in V-Dem’s coder-level data, Coppedge et al. 2024b ) and is computed with V-Dem’s measurement model, which adjusts for differences between experts in how they use the scale ( Pemstein et al., 2024 ) . Of the 9,063 country-indicator pairs, 9,041 have a V-Dem code and are scored.
blocks.zh: 我们使用V-Dem版本14(Coppedge等,2024c;Coppedge等,2024a.),编码为2023年,作为基准. 53个指标是魏德曼等人(2026年)从V-Dem的5个高级民主指数的组成部分中选取的普通、专家编码指标;仅在选举年份编码的指标不在其中。 每种代码都基于多个国家专家的评级(在V-Dem的编码器一级数据中,每条代码的中位数为6,Coppedge等人,2024年b),并采用V-Dem的计量模型进行计算,该模型根据专家在使用比额表方面的差异进行调整(Pemstein等人,2024年)。 在9,063个国别指标对中,9,041个有V-Dem代码并得分.

blocks.en: In a single task, Weidmann et al. (2026) code all 53 indicators with GPT-4o and Llama-3.1 70B, and then analyse how the models deviate systematically from V-Dem by country and as a function of disagreement between coders. We run the full task. For JEV, we use the V-Dem question as the instruction and “What is the score for [country] in 2023?” as the input. The ordered response scale gives the levels of a Score, and we remove the instruction to reply with a number. For GPT-6 Luna and Qwen we use the published prompt.
blocks.zh: 在一个单一的任务中,魏德曼等(2026年)用GPT-4o和Llama-3.1 70B编码所有53个指标,然后分析模型如何按国家系统地偏离V-Dem,并作为编码者之间分歧的一种函数. 我们完成全部任务 对JEV来说,我们用V-Dem问题作为指导,“2023年[国 的得分是多少?” 作为投入。 命令的响应尺度给出了分数的等分,我们删除指令,以数字回复. 对于GPT-6 Luna和Quen,我们使用公布的快取.

blocks.en: In both recall tasks the models answer from what they learned in training, not from a text they read. The expert placements and V-Dem codes were public before these models were trained, so high agreement may partly reflect recall of the benchmarks themselves. This matters most for V-Dem: Weidmann et al. (2026) used version 14 because it was released after GPT-4o and Llama-3.1 were trained, but JEV, GPT-6 Luna and Qwen3.8-27B were trained after its release, so the comparison with the published models may favour the newer models.
blocks.zh: 在两次召回任务中,模型都从训练中而不是从所读的文本中解答。 专家职位安排和V-DEM代码在培训这些模式之前是公开的,因此,高度一致可能部分反映了对基准本身的回顾。 这对V-Dem最为重要: Weidmann等 (2026) 使用14版本,因为它是在GPT-4o和Llama-3.1训练后发布的,但是JEV,GPT-6 Luna和Qune3.8-27B在发布后接受了训练,因此与所公布模型的比较可能有利于更新的模型.

blocks.en: In the V-Dem task, JEV has a small but clear lead over every model. Its mean correlation with V-Dem is higher than GPT-6 Luna’s by 0.05 [0.04, 0.07], GPT-4o’s by 0.05 [0.03, 0.06], Qwen3.8-27B’s by 0.09 [0.07, 0.11] and Llama-3.1 70B’s by 0.18 [0.16, 0.20].
blocks.zh: 在V-Dem任务中,JEV对每个型号都有一个小而明确的领先. 它与V-Dem的正相关度比GPT-6 Luna高0.05 [0.04,0.07],GPT-4o高0.05 [0.03,0.06],Qune3.8-27B高0.09 [0.07,0.11],Llama-3.1 70B高0.18 [0.16,0.20].

blocks.en: JEV’s advantage?
blocks.zh: JEV的优势?

blocks.en: JEV annotates and scales text in these political science contexts about as well as a mid-tier commercial LLM and, in many instances, as well as open-weight models that can be run locally. Further, JEV does not show much of a cost advantage over what is commercially available in autumn 2026. JEV does have a clear speed advantage. However, for most scholarly uses, speed is not a deciding factor. On these metrics, there is little reason to adopt JEV in place of traditional, token-based large language models.
blocks.zh: JEV在这些政治科学背景下对文本进行注释和分级,介绍中层商业LLM, 在许多情况下,还介绍可在当地运行的开放式模型。 此外,JEV与2026年秋天的商业供应相比,没有显示出很大的成本优势。 JEV确实具有明显的速度优势. 然而,对于大多数学术用途而言,速度不是一个决定因素。 在这些衡量标准上,没有什么理由要采用JEV来取代传统的以符号为基础的大型语言模型.

blocks.en: Beyond these metrics, JEV’s supposed calibration advantage might be another reason to prefer it over traditional LLMs. Probabilities help scholars in two ways. First, they rank texts by how likely each answer is, so researchers can screen a corpus for a rare category, or send the answers the model is least sure of to a human or a more capable (and expensive) LLM. For this the probabilities need to rank answers well, which AUROC measures. Second, researchers can weight each answer by its probability to build a continuous scale ( Licht et al., 2025 ) , or read the probabilities as rates. For this they also need to be calibrated, which ECE measures. Both uses rely on the probabilities being informative and available.
blocks.zh: 除了这些衡量标准之外,JEV假定的校正优势或许是更倾向于传统法学硕士的另一个原因。 概率在两个方面帮助了学者. 首先,它们根据每个答案的概率来排列文本, 所以研究者可以筛选一个稀有类别, 或者将模型最不确定的答案发送到一个人类或一个更能(和昂贵)的LLM. 为此,概率需要很好地排列答案,非洲团结和机会委员会衡量的答案是什么。 第二,研究者可以按每个回答的概率来加权,以建立连续尺度(Licht等,2025年),或者将概率读取为速率. 为此,它们也需要校正,这是欧洲经委会衡量的。 这两种用途都依赖于提供信息和可获得的概率。

blocks.en: As we noted in the introduction, some providers now report few token probabilities or none, and those GPT-6 Luna reports are mostly close to 0 or 1. Figure 1 shows this for the party comparisons in our replication of Di Leo et al. (2025) : 74% of Luna’s probabilities are below 0.01 or above 0.99, against 18% for JEV and 16% for Qwen. JEV returns more mid-range probabilities, as we would expect when two parties are close ideologically. Qwen does the same, so near-certainty is not a property of LLMs as such.
blocks.zh: 正如我们在导言所指出,一些提供者现在报告的迹象概率很少或没有,而GPT-6 Luna报告大多接近于0或1。 图1显示在我们复制的Di Leo等人(2025年)中的政党比较情况:月亮概率的74%低于0.01或高于0.99,而JEV为18%,Quen为16%。 JEV返回更多的中程概率,当两个政党在意识形态上接近时,我们预计会这样做。 Quen也这样做,所以接近确定性不是LLMs本身的财产.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Distribution of each model’s probability that the first party is the more right-wing, across all party comparisons in our replication of Di Leo et al. (2025) ( N N = 347,801; one Qwen reply was lost). For JEV the probability comes from a two-option Choice; for GPT-6 Luna and Qwen3.8-27B, from their first-token probabilities.
blocks.zh: 图1:在我们复制的Di Leo et al. (2025年)中,每个模型的第一当事方是比较右翼的概率分布(N = 347 801;一个Quen答复丢失). JEV的概率来自两个选项选择;对于GPT-6 Luna和Quen3.8-27B,概率来自他们的先入为主概率.

blocks.en: The difference in probabilities is indicative, but not conclusive, evidence of poor calibration in GPT-6 Luna. Figure 2 presents the expected calibration error (ECE, left panel; Naeini et al. 2015 ; Guo et al. 2017 ) and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC, right panel; Hanley and McNeil 1982 ). The former groups each model’s answers by its stated probability, compares that probability with the share of answers that agree with the human coders in each group, and averages the gaps, weighting by group size. An ECE of zero, for example, means that answers given with 80% probability agree with the human coders 80% of the time. An ECE of one would mean the model is 100% confident and got every answer wrong.
blocks.zh: 概率的差异是GPT-6 Luna中校正差的指示性而非结论性证据. 图2列出了预期的校正错误(欧洲经委会,左面板;Naeini等)。 2015; Guo等 2017)和接收器操作特征曲线下的区域(AUROC,右面板;Hanley和McNeil 1982.). 前者按每个模型的显示概率将每个模型的答案分组,将该概率与每个模型中与人类编码者一致的答案比例进行比较,并按组大小加权,平均差距. 例如,ECE为0, 意味着以80%的概率给出的答案与人类编码者80%的时间一致。 其中一个是欧洲经委会,这意味着该模式具有100%的信心,而且得到的答案都是错误的。

blocks.en: When each question is asked once, GPT-6 Luna has higher calibration error than JEV on all eight reading tasks with a categorical human label. This suggests that TypeSafe’s claims of better calibration might be warranted against Luna. The gap disappears on the open-ended survey pairs when we average over the two presentation orders, and it reverses on the attack-type task, where Luna writes its probabilities in its reply. Qwen3.8-27B’s calibration differs from JEV’s by type of task. Its calibration error is lower on the four pairwise tasks, higher on three of the four labelling tasks, and higher on both attack-type arms and both recall tasks. JEV’s advantage therefore holds relative to Luna’s token probabilities but not consistently relative to Qwen’s. Yet, Where JEV does show better calibration than Qwen, the differences are not dramatic.
blocks.zh: 当每个问题被问出一次时,GPT-6 Luna在所有8个带有绝对人类标签的读取任务上,校正出错都高于JEV. 这表明TypeSafe对Luna提出更好的校准要求可能是有道理的。 差距在我们平均超过两个演示命令时消失在了开放式的勘测对上,它倒行逆施了攻击型任务,而Luna在回信中写出它的概率. Quen3.8-27 (中文(简体) ). B校正与JEV不同, 它的校正误差在四个对称任务上较低,在四个标签任务中有三个更高,攻击型武器和两个召回任务都更高. 因此,JEV的优势与Luna的象征性概率相对,但与Quen的优势并不一致。 不过, JEV确实表现出比Quen更好的校正,差异并不戏剧性.

blocks.en: The AUROC presents a similar picture. It is the chance that a randomly chosen right answer gets a higher probability than a randomly chosen wrong one. Luna’s AUROC is lower than JEV’s on seven of the eight tasks and level on the other, and lower than Qwen’s on all eight. On attack type, where it writes its probabilities, Luna’s AUROC is above Qwen’s in both arms and above JEV’s only when given the codebook. JEV and Qwen are not consistently different.
blocks.zh: 阿拉伯区域办事处也提供了类似的情况。 随机选择的正确答案比随机选择的错误答案得到的概率更高。 Luna的AUROC在8个任务中的7个和另一个级别上都低于JEV,在全部8个级别上都低于Quen. 在攻击类型上,Luna的AUROC写着它的概率,只有在给了代码簿时,它才在双臂和JEV以上都高于Quen。 JEV和Quen并非一贯不同.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Calibration of JEV, GPT-6 Luna and Qwen3.8-27B against human coders, by task, with 95% bootstrap intervals. Left: calibration error (ECE), the gap between the probability a model gives its answer and the share of such answers that agree with the human label, over ten probability bins; lower is better. Right: AUROC, the chance that a correct answer gets a higher probability than an incorrect one; 0.5 is chance. Top rows: each question asked once. Middle rows: probabilities averaged over the two presentation orders. Bottom rows: on attack type GPT-6 Luna and Qwen write their probabilities in the reply; party positions and democracy indicators are recall tasks. In the attack-type and party-position rows, which have tens or hundreds of thousands of items, the intervals are narrower than the markers. Appendix H describes the Licht and MARPOR tasks.
blocks.zh: 图2:JEV,GPT-6 Luna和Qune3.8-27B对人编码器的校正,按任务划分,靴子间隔为95%. 左:校正出错(ECE),一个模型的概率之间的空隙给出了它的答案,和符合人类标签的这种答案的比例,超过十个概率的宾箱;更低的更好. 对:AUROC,正确答案得到比不正确概率更高的概率;0.5是概率. 上行:每问一次. 中行:在两种呈现顺序上,概率平均. 下行:指攻击型为GPT-6 Luna和Quen在回函中写出其概率;政党立场和民主指标是召回任务. 在有数以万计或数十万计物品的攻击型和会场位置行中,间隔比标分更窄. 附录H描述了Licht和MARPOR的任务.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: Our analysis indicates that JEV is a capable model for text scaling and annotation in political science contexts. However, there are no major gains in cost or capabilities that make it a clear choice for most applications. The main advantages lie in its speed and ease of parsing the underlying probabilities. When each question is asked once, JEV’s probabilities are also better calibrated than GPT-6 Luna’s token probabilities, though not consistently better than those of Qwen3.8-27B. As such, the choice to use JEV over other LLMs is task dependent. In some cases, JEV might offer more accurate calibration while still performing on par with LLMs for social science tasks. Our analysis suggest that this still requires that researchers validate JEV as they would other LLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析表明,JEV是政治科学背景下文本缩放和注释的能动模型. 然而,在成本或能力方面没有重大收益,使它成为大多数应用的明确选择。 主要优点在于其速度快而易于分析潜在的概率。 当每个问题被问出一次时,JEV的概率也比出自GPT-6 Luna的相标概率更好校正,虽然与出自Qune3.8-27B的概率相比并非一贯好. 因此,使用JEV而不是其他LLMM的选择取决于任务. 在某些情况下,JEV可能提供更准确的校准,同时仍与LLMS同等执行社会科学任务. 我们的分析表明,这仍需要研究人员像其他有限责任公司那样验证JEV。

blocks.en: Study 1: interest-rate knowledge
blocks.zh: 研究1:利率知识

blocks.en: Open-ended item. In a few sentences and without looking it up, can you explain how interest rates (i.e. the cost of borrowing money to buy a house or car) go up or down in the US economy?
blocks.zh: 不限成员名额的项目。 在几句话里,不问高低,你能否解释一下利率(即借钱购买房屋或汽车的成本)如何在美国经济中上升或下降?

blocks.en: Instructions. You are an expert in US economic policy. blocks.en: Instructions. In this job, you will be shown a sample of Tweets collected from the social media platform Twitter. Your task will be to determine if the Tweets have to do with “content” moderation” or not. “Content moderation” refers to the practice of screening and monitoring content posted by users on social media sites to determine if the content should be published or not, based on specific rules and guidelines. Every time someone posts something on a platform like Facebook or Twitter, that piece of content goes through a review process (‘content moderation’) to ensure that it is not illegal, hateful or inappropriate and that it complies with the rules of the site. When that is not the case, that piece of content can be removed, flagged, labelled as or ‘disputed’. Deciding what should be allowed on social media is not always easy. For example, many sites ban child pornography and terrorist content as it is illegal. However, things are less clear when it comes to content about the safety of vaccines or politics, for example. Even when people agree that some content should be blocked, they do not always agree about the best way to do so, about how effective it is and who should do it (the government or private companies, human moderators or artificial intelligence). For each tweet in the sample: Carefully read the text of the Tweet, paying close attention to details. Classify the Tweet as either irrelevant (0) or relevant (1). Tweets should be coded as relevant when they directly relate to content moderation. This includes Tweets that discuss social media platforms’ content moderation rules and practices, and Tweets that discuss governments’ regulation of online content moderation. This also includes Tweets that discuss mild forms of content moderation, like flagging Tweets and Tweets when they indirectly relate to content moderation. Tweets should be coded as irrelevant if they do not refer to content moderation or if they are themselves examples of moderated content. This would include, for example, a Tweet by Donald Trump that Twitter has labelled as ‘disputed’, a Tweet claiming that something is false, or a Tweet containing sensitive content.

blocks.en: This field captures the general method of attack and often reflects the broad class of tactics used. It consists of nine categories, which are defined below. Up to three attack types can be recorded for each incident. Typically, only one attack type is recorded for each incident unless the attack is comprised of a sequence of events.

blocks.en: Options. • Assassination : An act whose primary objective is to kill one or more specific, prominent individuals. Usually carried out on persons of some note, such as high-ranking military officers, government officials, celebrities, etc. Not to include attacks on non-specific members of a targeted group. The killing of a police officer would be an armed assault unless there is reason to believe the attackers singled out a particularly prominent officer for assassination. • Armed Assault : An attack whose primary objective is to cause physical harm or death directly to human beings by use of a firearm, incendiary, or sharp instrument (knife, etc.). Not to include attacks involving the use of fists, rocks, sticks, or other handheld (less-than-lethal) weapons. Also includes attacks involving certain classes of explosive devices in addition to firearms, incendiaries, or sharp instruments. The explosive device subcategories that are included in this classification are grenades, projectiles, and unknown or other explosive devices that are thrown. • Bombing/Explosion : An attack where the primary effects are caused by an energetically unstable material undergoing rapid decomposition and releasing a pressure wave that causes physical damage to the surrounding environment. Can include either high or low explosives (including a dirty bomb) but does not include a nuclear explosive device that releases energy from fission and/or fusion, or an incendiary device where decomposition takes place at a much slower rate. If an attack involves certain classes of explosive devices along with firearms, incendiaries, or sharp objects, then the attack is coded as an armed assault only. The explosive device subcategories that are included in this classification are grenades, projectiles, and unknown or other explosive devices that are thrown in which the bombers are also using firearms or incendiary devices. • Hijacking : An act whose primary objective is to take control of a vehicle such as an aircraft, boat, bus, etc. for the purpose of diverting it to an unprogrammed destination, force the release of prisoners, or some other political objective. Obtaining payment of a ransom should not the sole purpose of a Hijacking, but can be one element of the incident so long as additional objectives have also been stated. Hijackings are distinct from Hostage Taking because the target is a vehicle, regardless of whether there are people/passengers in the vehicle. • Hostage Taking (Barricade Incident) : An act whose primary objective is to take control of hostages for the purpose of achieving a political objective through concessions or through disruption of normal operations. Such attacks are distinguished from kidnapping since the incident occurs and usually plays out at the target location with little or no intention to hold the hostages for an extended period in a separate clandestine location. • Hostage Taking (Kidnapping) : An act whose primary objective is to take control of hostages for the purpose of achieving a political objective through concessions or through disruption of normal operations. Kidnappings are distinguished from Barricade Incidents (above) in that they involve moving and holding the hostages in another location. • Facility/Infrastructure Attack : An act, excluding the use of an explosive, whose primary objective is to cause damage to a non-human target, such as a building, monument, train, pipeline, etc. Such attacks include arson and various forms of sabotage (e.g., sabotaging a train track is a facility/infrastructure attack, even if passengers are killed). Facility/infrastructure attacks can include acts which aim to harm an installation, yet also cause harm to people incidentally (e.g. an arson attack primarily aimed at damaging a building, but causes injuries or fatalities). • Unarmed Assault : An attack whose primary objective is to cause physical harm or death directly to human beings by any means other than explosive, firearm, incendiary, or sharp instrument (knife, etc.). Attacks involving chemical, biological or radiological weapons are considered unarmed assaults. • Unknown : The attack type cannot be determined from the available information.

Only some of these diagnostics need the probability. Position bias, the
choice-based transitivity measures and test-retest agreement on the winner can
be measured from choices alone, and the published article reports the
sparse-triplet measure for its six models (below). Calibration, the
stochastic forms of transitivity and any conditioning on reported confidence
require the probability, which a generative model that exposes token
log-probabilities can also supply, so a typed output does not make any of these
diagnostics possible for the first time. What it changes is that the
probability arrives with every judgment, defined over the named options and at
no extra cost, and
that no answer falls outside the set. Nothing has to be extracted from token probabilities. Whether the probability carries
information is then a question about this model, and the flip rates in Table 3 bear
on it. We have no token probabilities for the published generative scorers.
We do for GPT-6 Luna. Averaged over the two orders, its calibration error
against the raters is level with JEV’s; in single calls it is higher (0.145
against 0.071). Its interface omits low-probability alternatives, so many of
its probabilities are exactly 0 or 1. Qwen3.8-27B, whose token probabilities we also have, is
better calibrated than JEV on these pairs (0.011 against 0.071 in single calls).

blocks.en:
Asking each pair in both orders identifies the position effect, which a
single-order design cannot. In Study 1 the model favours the second-listed
statement, with a bias of − - 0.0358 on the probability scale ( − - 0.0373 on the choice scale; negative values favour the second slot); in Study 2 the bias on the probability scale is
0.0030. Flip rates are near-identical across the two studies (8.8% and 8.5%) while
the direction of the flips differs, which suggests the effect depends on the
question rather than being a fixed characteristic of the model. TypeSafe reports that the model leans toward
the first option of a Choice. In Study 1 it leans toward the second, so that
documented tendency does not explain the Study 1 result. Consequences for
the recovered scale are small: scores from forward and reversed presentations
correlate at 0.982. The published models were each run in a single
order, so their departures from an even split confound position bias with any
genuine imbalance between slots, and we do not compare magnitudes across the two
designs.

blocks.en: What the vendor states
blocks.zh: 卖家说的

blocks.en:
TypeSafe says it built JEV with “a new architecture, a new sampler, and a new
training algorithm” ( TypeSafe, 2026 ) . It describes none of the three
technically. It calls the sampler parallel, producing every output in one query
instead of token by token, and says JEV writes no text and is not a chat or
code-completion LLM. It describes its training method, Reinforcement Learning for
Calibrated Decisions (RLCD), only by its aim, calibrated probabilities, and
gives no formal objective for it. TypeSafe says it makes its own training data,
and its chief executive told TechCrunch that the data are exclusively synthetic
while saying little about the architecture ( Fernholz, 2026 ) . That account would
not rule out that the model has seen our benchmarks, since text another model
writes carries what that model learned; a benchmark built after the version
date would settle it. TypeSafe’s primer presents RLCD as a third way,
after reinforcement learning from human feedback and from verifiable rewards, to
post-train pretrained language models, which we read as implying an unnamed
pretrained base. The same weights serve every customer.

blocks.en:
We do not know the architecture (encoder, decoder, diffusion or otherwise),
whether a request is one forward pass, the parameter count, or which base or
teacher model, if any, JEV derives from. Nor do we know how options and levels
are scored, what an output token counts, or whether replay variation arises in
the model or the serving stack. TypeSafe publishes no model changelog. We
therefore cannot tell whether the weights changed between our collection dates.

Nothing in the outputs separates a new architecture from a pretrained or
distilled language model whose scores over the answer set are read off,
rounded and renormalised. Rounding to hundredths, the sum-to-one adjustment, a
confidence computed from the top probability, schema-fixed output-token counts
and small replay variation are properties of an interface, and a language model
behind a constrained output head could produce every one of them. A technical report, open weights
or a named base model would settle the question. Short of that, two checks on
the archive would bear on it without settling it: whether the input-token
counts the endpoint reports match one tokenizer family exactly, which would
point to a base model from that family if the vendor counts with the model’s
own tokenizer, and whether the model’s disagreements with other scorers coincide
with one generative model’s more often than shared difficulty explains, which
would point to a teacher model. We have run neither.

Three further observations stand out. First, GPT-6

party duplets it chose the party listed second more often than the expert

many of its token probabilities are exactly 0, 0.5 or 1, and a score built from
them is coarser than GPT-4’s. The scripts, request files and every response are
in the replication archive.

blocks.en: An open-weight comparator: Qwen3.8-27B
blocks.zh: 开放式比较器:Quen3.8-27B

blocks.en: We also performed all of the tests on an open-weight model, Qwen3.8-27B, on 30 September 2026. We ran the model through OpenRouter, pinned to a single host (Parasail, which serves the model at 8-bit precision, FP8), with reasoning off, a temperature of 0, and the twenty most probable tokens returned for each position in its reply. We sent it the same messages, byte for byte, as in the matching GPT-6 Luna request. All replies came from that host, and the only replies lost, to a host error, were those for one party duplet and one GTD incident. We tabulate the differences from JEV in Table 10 , using the same conventions as in Table 9 . Qwen is level with or above JEV for four of the seven applications (tweets, sentiment, survey, and manifestos and speeches) and below JEV for three (attack type, party positions and democracy indicators). It scores above JEV for sentiment and, in the 2023 sample, for tweet relevance and problem framing, but below it for solution framing in the 2021 sample. For the seven primary tasks, it cost between 2.35 and 5.41 times as much per decision as JEV, in part because this route does not have a batch rate.
blocks.zh: 我们还在2026年9月30日进行了开口量产型号Quen3.8-27B的所有测试. 我们通过OpenRouter运行了模型,它被固定在一个单一的主机上(Parasail,它以8位精度服务于模型,FP8),其推理减速,温度为0,在回复中返回了每个位置最有可能的二十个符号. 我们发送了相同的消息,字节的字节, 就像匹配的GPT-6 Luna请求。 所有答复都来自东道方,对东道方的错误,唯一损失的答复是一方的回答和一次GTD事件。 我们使用与表9相同的公约,在表10中列出与JEV的差异。 Quen在7个申请中的4个申请与JEV处于或高于水平(tweets,情感,调查,以及宣言和演讲),在JEV以下的3个申请(攻击类型,政党立场和民主指标). 它的评分高于JEV的评分,在2023年的样本中,评分高于推特相关性和问题框架,但低于2021年的样本中的解决方案框架. 7个初级任务,其成本是JEV决定的2.35至5.41倍,部分原因是这条路线没有批发率.

blocks.en: Additional calibration tasks
blocks.zh: 额外的校正任务

blocks.en: Four tasks in Figure 2 (seven of its rows) come from outside the seven replications. We added them because each has a human label and all three models give probabilities. Three use pairwise comparison data that Licht et al. (2025) reuse. In WiscAds ( Carlson and Montgomery, 2017 ) , the model reads the text of two television advertisements from the 2008 US Senate elections and picks the more negative one (1,944 pairs). In Immigration ( Carlson and Montgomery, 2017 ) , it picks the statement that expresses more fear or worry about the effects of immigration (3,265 pairs). In Park ( Park, 2021 ) , it picks the paragraph from a House committee hearing that is more grandstanding and less information-seeking (2,228 pairs). The answer counted as correct is the text with the higher score on the Bradley-Terry scale estimated from the human coders’ comparisons. Each model sees every pair in all four combinations of presentation order and label order, using the prompts of Licht et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 图2中的4个任务(其行中7个)来自7个复制外. 我们添加它们是因为每个都有一个人类的标签 所有三个模型都给出了概率。 Licht等人(2025年)三次使用对等比较数据进行再利用。 在"WiscAds"(Carlson and Montgomery, 2017)中,模型读取了2008年美国参议院选举的两部电视广告的正文并选取了更负的一幅(1,944对). 在"移民"(Carlson and Montgomery, 2017)中,它选取了表达更多恐惧或担心移民影响的声明(3,265对). 在Park (Park, 2021)中,它从一个更出名和较少寻求信息的众议院委员会听证会(2,228对)中取出段落. 答案是准确的, 每个模型在呈现顺序和标签顺序的所有四个组合中都看到每对,使用Licht等人(2025年)的提示.

blocks.en: The fourth task screens manifesto sentences for the European Union. On a random 10% of the Manifesto Project corpus ( Lehmann et al., 2025 ) , 121,877 human-coded sentences, each model gives the probability that a sentence concerns the EU, and we score it against the human codes for the two EU categories (108 and 110). EU sentences are rare, so the calibration error is small for every model.
blocks.zh: 第四个任务为欧洲联盟筛选宣言的句子。 在"宣言"(Munificationo Project)的任意10%(Lehmann等,2025年),121,877个被人编码的句子上,每个模型都给出了一个句子涉及欧盟的概率,我们比照两个欧盟类别(108和110)的人编码来评分. 欧盟的句子很少见,因此每个模型的校正出错都很小.
